overview: When the built-in Framer tools cannot do what you want, we write the part that is missing. That can be a pricing calculator, a filtered gallery, a custom cursor, a scroll effect, a before and after slider or a live feed. We build it as a reusable component with controls you can change in the editor, test it on all screen sizes and keep it light so your pages stay fast.

faq: Do I need to know code to use the components?
No. We build them with property controls, so you change text, colors and options in the Framer panel just as you would for built-in elements.
Will custom code slow my site?
We keep code small and load it only where it is needed. We check the page speed before and after, and we avoid heavy libraries when a few lines will do.
Can you copy an effect from another site?
We can build a similar effect from your description. We do not copy another site's code or protected design, and we write our own implementation.
What if Framer changes and breaks a component?
We build with supported Framer code methods to reduce the risk. If an update affects it after our fix window, our management service or a small order can repair it.
